Ranks Montgomery census tracts by adult diabetes prevalence percentage from CDC PLACES, joining tract names and retaining adult population as the denominator, with nulls last and geoid last for mapping.
sql:
WITH cdc AS (
  SELECT
    tractfips AS geoid,
    CAST(diabetes_crudeprev AS DOUBLE) AS adult_diabetes_prevalence_per_adult,
    CAST(totalpop18plus AS BIGINT) AS adult_population
  FROM session.fw_ad2e8f_m1_cdc
)
SELECT
  t.name,
  c.adult_diabetes_prevalence_per_adult,
  c.adult_population,
  t.geoid
FROM fw_pg.tracts t
LEFT JOIN cdc c ON t.geoid = c.geoid
ORDER BY c.adult_diabetes_prevalence_per_adult DESC NULLS LAST, t.name ASC
LIMIT 200
